description: This file declares the ActiveRequests class and its nested ActiveRequestsData class, which manage active media requests within a media server component. It includes methods for inserting, erasing, and retrieving media request data, as well as adding media segments to requests.

classes.name: ActiveRequests
classes.description: Manages active media requests, allowing insertion, removal, and segment management.

classes.name: ActiveRequestsData
classes.description: Holds data for a specific media request, including its type, segments, and media byte limits.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new media request with specified source type and max media bytes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type for a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a request by request ID or media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a specific request.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all media segments associated with a request.
